verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote desktop and streaming product whose Teams tier includes admin reporting and audit logs, so AI-generated insights on that data are a conceivable capability. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of any AI-generated insights, suggestions, or analysis features. Audit logs and API reporting are adjacent data features, not AI insights, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
